title: The Bee at the Beach
lines: Ana and her mom went to the beach.
They had a meal of peach and tea.
A bee came and sat on the peach.
Ana did not want to eat with a bee.
She sent it off, but it came back.
Ana set the peach bit on a flat rock.
The bee went to the rock and sat.
Ana ate the rest and went to sleep.
She had a dream of a green sea.
Then Mom woke her up with a soft pat.
Ana swam in the green sea with her mom.
It was the best beach day yet.

questions.ask: What did Ana and her mom have at the beach?
questions.listenFor: A meal of peach and tea.

questions.ask: How did Ana get the bee off her peach?
questions.listenFor: She set the peach bit on a flat rock. Sending the bee off had not worked, as it came back.

questions.ask: Was Ana right to let the bee have the peach? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer works. Listen for the reason more than the answer.
